description: This PHP file is part of the TestLink project and is responsible for generating and displaying test execution results in various formats, including HTML and XLS. It includes functions for initializing report parameters, building data matrices, handling spreadsheets, and sending reports via email. The file references various external classes and configurations related to test plan metrics, templates, and email handling, indicating its role in reporting and result visualization within the testing framework.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class for rendering external (probably JavaScript-based) rich tables for displaying test results matrix.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: Class for generating standard HTML tables for presenting testing data.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds an external JavaScript-powered table for displaying test case results, with grouping and sorting features.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Creates email configuration details including subject and recipients based on the GUI context.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the graphical user interface parameters, including labels, options, and related information for the results report.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet report of test results, including optional email sending.

methods.name: setCellRangeSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates a list of cell references for Excel column ranges.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Initializes the spreadsheet with header information about the test project and plan.
